# Send the email with birth certificate attachment
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()

gmail_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
phone_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
fs_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]

# Husband email from phone contacts (relationship='husband')
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='6017026518', password=phone_pw)['access_token']
husband_contacts=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', relationship='husband', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    husband_contacts.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

print('husband_contacts_count', len(husband_contacts))
husband_email = husband_contacts[0].get('email') if len(husband_contacts)==1 else None
print('husband_email', husband_email)

# Gmail + file_system tokens
gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)['access_token']
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=fs_pw)['access_token']

attachment_path = '/home/kristin/documents/personal/identity/birth_certificate.pdf'
subject = 'Birth Certificate'
body = 'Hi Alex,\n\nAttached is the birth certificate from my files.\n\nLove,\nKristin'

send_resp = apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=[husband_email],
